title: OMGP golden byte vector
description: One immutable vector: the field values, their canonical rendering, and the exact bytes the reference implementation produced from them. Files under tests/vectors/ are never edited to make a test pass (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

name.description: Also the file stem and the C++ identifier suffix (V_<name>).

spec_ref.description: Protocol document section exercised, e.g. 'protocol-l3 §3.1 SET_PARAM'.

fields.description: Typed input values. For kind=message: opcode (name), node_id, seq, flags, then payload fields in layout order; for kind=descriptor: {"records": [ {"type": <name|int>, ...fields } ]}.

canonical.description: Rendering of fields per contracts/canonical-text.md (ASCII only).

bytes.description: Upper-case hex octets separated by single spaces; empty string allowed for zero-length payload vectors only when kind=message and payload_len=0 (header bytes are still present, so in practice never empty).

note.description: Optional human note (e.g. 'boundary: value at max').
